articles.abstract_en: We document that countries partially default often and with varying intensity, resulting in lengthy episodes and hump-shaped patterns for partial default and debt. Default episodes lead to haircuts for lenders but not to reductions in debt, because the defaulted debt accumulates and borrowing continues. We present a theory of partial default rationalizing these patterns and the heterogeneity of partial default, and partial default’s comovements with spreads, debt, and output that are absent in standard sovereign default theory. We include policy counterfactuals in the form of pari passu and no-dilution clauses and debt-relief policies, and their welfare implications.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了国家经常以不同强度进行部分违约，导致部分违约和债务出现漫长的阶段和驼峰状模式。违约事件导致贷款人遭受减记，但并未减少债务，因为违约债务会累积且借款仍在继续。我们提出了一个部分违约理论，解释了这些模式、部分违约的异质性，以及部分违约与利差、债务和产出的联动，而这些联动在标准主权违约理论中是不存在的。我们纳入了政策反事实分析，形式包括同等权益条款、禁止稀释条款和债务减免政策，及其福利影响。

articles.abstract_en: We show that with indivisible goods, the existence of competitive equilibrium fundamentally depends on agents’ substitution effects, not their income effects. Our equilibrium existence duality allows us to transport results on the existence of competitive equilibrium from settings with transferable utility to settings with income effects. One consequence is that net substitutability—which is a strictly weaker condition than gross substitutability—is sufficient for the existence of competitive equilibrium. Further applications give new existence results beyond the case of (net) substitutes. Our results have implications for auction design.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们证明，在不可分割商品的情况下，竞争均衡的存在性根本上取决于代理人的替代效应，而非收入效应。我们的均衡存在性对偶使我们能够将竞争均衡存在性的结果从可转移效用环境迁移到具有收入效应的环境中。一个推论是，净替代性——这是比总替代性严格更弱的条件——足以保证竞争均衡的存在。进一步的应用给出了超越（净）替代情形的新存在性结果。我们的结果对拍卖设计具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: The Lasting Effects of Early-Childhood Education on Promoting the Skills and Social Mobility of Disadvantaged African Americans and Their Children
articles.title_cn: 早期儿童教育对促进弱势非裔美国人及其子女技能与社会流动性的持久影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper demonstrates the long-term intragenerational and intergenerational benefits of the HighScope Perry Preschool Project, which targeted disadvantaged African-American children. We use newly collected data on the original participants through late middle age and on their children into their mid-twenties. We document long-lasting improvements in the original participants' skills, marriage stability, earnings, criminal behavior, and health. Beneficial program impacts through the childrearing years translate into better family environments for their children leading to intergenerational gains. Children of the original participants have higher levels of education and employment, lower levels of criminal activity, and better health than children of the controls.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文展示了HighScope佩里学前项目对弱势非裔美国儿童的长期代内和代际益处。我们使用了新收集的原始参与者至中年晚期及其子女至二十多岁的数据。我们记录了原始参与者在技能、婚姻稳定性、收入、犯罪行为和健康方面的持久改善。通过育儿年间的有益项目影响转化为对其子女更好的家庭环境，从而带来代际收益。原始参与者的子女在教育和就业水平上更高，犯罪活动水平更低，健康状况优于对照组子女。

articles.title_cn: 多产品市场的帕累托改进分割
articles.abstract_en: We investigate whether a market served by a multiproduct monopolistic seller can be segmented in a way that benefits all consumers and the seller. The seller can offer a different product menu in each market segment, combining second- and third-degree price discrimination. We show that markets for which profit maximization leads to inefficiency can, generically, be segmented into two market segments in a way that increases the surplus of all consumers weakly and of some consumers and the seller strictly. Our constructive proof is based on deriving implications of binding incentive compatibility constraints when profit maximization implies inefficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个由多产品垄断卖方服务的市场是否可以通过一种使所有消费者和卖方受益的方式进行分割。卖方可以在每个市场细分中提供不同的产品菜单，结合二级和三级价格歧视。我们表明，对于利润最大化导致无效率的市场，通常可以将其分割为两个市场细分，从而弱增加所有消费者的剩余，并严格增加部分消费者和卖方的剩余。我们的构造性证明基于在利润最大化意味着无效率时，推导绑定激励相容约束的含义。

articles.title_en: Voluntary Interaction and the Principle of Mutual Benefit
articles.abstract_en: Most social preference theories are based on observations of nonvoluntary interactions. Nonselfish behavior may take fundamentally different forms in voluntary interactions, such as market transactions. We investigate the “Principle of Mutual Benefit”—an injunctive norm requiring individuals who enter interactions voluntarily to conform to common expectations about behavior within them. This norm induces patterns of behavior inconsistent with existing social preference theories and allows extrinsic incentives to crowd in trustworthiness. We embed this norm in a model consistent with evidence about promise keeping, gift exchange, and “avoiding the ask.” We present new experimental evidence that people adhere to it.
articles.abstract_cn: 大多数社会偏好理论基于对非自愿互动的观察。在自愿互动（如市场交易）中，非自私行为可能呈现根本不同的形式。我们研究了“互利原则”——一种要求自愿进入互动的人遵守其中行为共同期望的命令性规范。该规范引发了与现有社会偏好理论不一致的行为模式，并允许外在激励挤入可信赖性。我们将此规范嵌入一个与关于信守承诺、礼物交换和“回避请求”的证据相一致的模型中。我们提供了新的实验证据，表明人们遵守这一规范。
